purpose: Teach: 磁気/健在/ピット/地雷/風車/衣類/ふれあい/エキス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、磁気のおもちゃは小さなお子に注意ね
lines.en: Sho, those magnetic toys need careful handling with little ones, okay?
lines.style: Gentle reminder, warm but serious. A slight pause after his name. Soft authority—not commanding, just looking out. The tone of someone who knows he'll listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんがご健在で嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm so happy Grandpa is doing well.
lines.style: Bright, genuine warmth in the voice. A quick lift on 'happy'—the kind of uncomplicated joy six-year-olds have. Steady eye contact. No performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレースのピット作業のお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about his work in the pit crew—it sounds really interesting.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Leaning slightly into the memory of the conversation. Warm—sharing something he told her that matters to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、社会で地雷の単元を勉強したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we learned about landmines in social studies, and I wanted to tell you about it.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly solemn. The pride of learning something serious. Speaking carefully, like it matters that she knows. A small breath before the last phrase.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、オランダ風車の絵本、メイ姉さんが買ってくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, I found this beautiful picture book about Dutch windmills and I bought it just for you.
lines.style: Bright, a touch of conspiratorial pleasure. The delight of having found something perfect for him. Warm weight on 'just for you'—like a small secret gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、衣類の整理ができるようになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned how to organize my clothes by myself now.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. A small lift—not bragging, just genuinely pleased with himself. Waiting slightly for her reaction, like it matters that she knows.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、地域のふれあいイベントに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the community event together, okay?
lines.style: Gentle invitation, warm and unhurried. The tenderness of including him in something. Slight pause after his name. Not a command—an invitation he'll want to say yes to.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんが薬草のエキスをくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandma gave me this special herb extract—it smells so good.
lines.style: Eager, close to her. A bright smile in the voice. Quick, excited. The warmth of having something special to share with someone he trusts.
